content:
[project]
name = "personal-historical-archive"
version = "0.47.0"
description = "Personal Historical Archive (pha): local archive of historical documents (manuscripts, old books, maps, ...) — drop folder + VLM text extraction (Ollama/LM Studio) + index + MCP search"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "pymupdf>=1.24",
    "watchdog>=4.0",
    "httpx>=0.27",
    "numpy>=1.26",
    "jsonschema>=4.0",
    "PyYAML>=6.0",
    "fastmcp>=2.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.30",
    "sse-starlette>=2.0",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest>=8"]

[project.scripts]
pha = "personal_historical_archive.cli:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/personal_historical_archive"]

# Ship the canonical JSON Schema inside the wheel. It lives at the repo root
# (schema/pha-sidecar.schema.json) because that path is the schema's published
# $id and what existing pha.yaml files point their editors at, but a built
# distribution must also carry a copy under the package so the loader can find
# it via importlib.resources on any install. See
# enhancements/pha-installed-wheel-missing-schema-bug-report.md.
[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
"schema/pha-sidecar.schema.json" = "personal_historical_archive/schema/pha-sidecar.schema.json"
# The pipeline explanation is authored at the repo root as PIPELINE.md and is
# seeded into every archive (README.md / AGENTS.md / PIPELINE.md are refreshed
# on each run). A built install has no repo-root file to read, so the wheel
# carries a copy under the package for archive_init.pipeline_doc_template.
"PIPELINE.md" = "personal_historical_archive/PIPELINE.md"
# Every `pha help <topic>` file. A wheel install has no checkout, so without
# these `pha help mcp` (and the rest) printed a path that did not exist; the
# build carries them under the package and cli._help_doc_path reads them with
# importlib.resources. Same reasoning as PIPELINE.md above.
"README.md" = "personal_historical_archive/README.md"
"MCP_CLIENTS.md" = "personal_historical_archive/MCP_CLIENTS.md"
"HISTORIANS_README.md" = "personal_historical_archive/HISTORIANS_README.md"
"AGENTS.md" = "personal_historical_archive/AGENTS.md"
"MULTI_COMPUTER.md" = "personal_historical_archive/MULTI_COMPUTER.md"
"HARNESS_INTRODUCTION.md" = "personal_historical_archive/HARNESS_INTRODUCTION.md"
# The plugin's own documentation: `pha help view` points at the quick start, and
# the full install/development reference sits beside it under the same relative
# path, so the quick start's link to `dsh-pha/README.md` resolves in an install
# as well as in the checkout.
"DSH_PLUGIN.md" = "personal_historical_archive/DSH_PLUGIN.md"
"dsh-pha/README.md" = "personal_historical_archive/dsh-pha/README.md"
"src/personal_historical_archive/CHANGELOG.json" = "personal_historical_archive/CHANGELOG.json"
"dsh-pha/package.json" = "personal_historical_archive/_view/package.json"
"dsh-pha/lib/index.js" = "personal_historical_archive/_view/lib/index.js"
"dsh-pha/lib/client.js" = "personal_historical_archive/_view/lib/client.js"
